summary:
5 structured Omni Flash JSON video prompts for testing Stikaman channel visual style. One prompt per planned video:
1. Banned Weapons — crossbow kills knight (action sequence test)
2. Banned Books — dictionary gets BANNED stamp (comedy/object test)
3. Dumb War Tactics — Trojan Horse reveal (night scene + multiple figures)
4. Greek Mythology — Medusa petrification (transformation effect test)
5. Bullet Types — expanding bullet cross-section (technical diagram + slow-mo)

Each prompt uses SLCT framework + time-indexed action blocks. Includes a testing matrix showing what each prompt validates and fallback plans if Omni Flash fails.
